🇺🇸 🎮 ⚡️ - Grand Theft Auto VI has a 4.9/10 on Metacritic after user reviews were opened. 🇺🇸 🎮 - Most of the criticism against Grand Theft Auto VI has been for its player dynamic. The game took a big departure from previous installments centered on open-world criminal activity, with a lot of user reviews noting "pointless errands," comparing the game to "The Sims," and complaining about the "simp" nature of the relationship between the two playable protagonists. Indeed, most of the reviews have praised the graphics, detail, and overall advancement of the world compared to other Grand Theft Auto games. As one user wrote, GTA VI is like "PG18 Sims with more realism."

🇺🇸 ⚡️ - BREAKING: Hackers breached the Department of Agriculture earlier this week, according to NBC News. The cyberattack targeted the database that sends payments to farmers, and potentially gained access to other classified information. 🇺🇸 ⚡️ - "The two former USDA officials said once hackers penetrate a database that sends payments to farmers, they may be able to access other information the agency stores, including related to food safety or research on animal-borne illnesses. One of them stressed that much of the USDA’s food screening is done by employees in the field. 'There’s a bunch of scary biologic issues that the USDA thinks about very frequently, and that’s all stuff that we keep secure within the United States because if an adversary or a competitor were to have access to that same information...they could use our own research against us,' the former USDA official said." - NBC News
